relations.subject: Carl Gustav Hermann Salemann
relations.evidence: After gymnasium in Tallinn in 1859-67 studied Arabic, Persian, Turkish and Sanskrit at Oriental Faculty, St.Petersburg University. Cand. 1871

relations.subject: Carl Gustav Hermann Salemann
relations.evidence: From 1875 Assistant Librarian and 1879-90 Librarian of St.Petersburg University.

relations.subject: Carl Gustav Hermann Salemann
relations.evidence: From 1890 Director of Asian Museum in St.Petersburg, until death.

relations.subject: Carl Gustav Hermann Salemann
relations.evidence: From 1876 also Docent of Avesta and Pahlavi at St.Petersburg University, taught there until death.

relations.subject: Carl Gustav Hermann Salemann
relations.evidence: Also at Imperial Academy: Adjunkt 1886, eo. 1889 and full member 1895.
